dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: This graph illustrates how students use English during the year.
dialogue.reading: ðɪs ˈɡræf ˈɪləstreɪts ˈhaʊ ˈstuːdənts ˈjuːz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈdʊrɪŋ ðə ˈjɪr.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: What does the vertical line represent?
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt dʌz ðə ˈvɜːrtɪkəl ˈlaɪn ˌrɛprɪˈzɛnt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It represents hours per week. And the other line represents the months.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˌrɛprɪˈzɛnts ˈaʊərz pər ˈwiːk. ənd ði ˈʌðər ˈlaɪn ˌrɛprɪˈzɛnts ðə ˈmʌnθs.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: I see. So when does English use peak?
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈsiː. soʊ ˈwɛn dʌz ˈɪŋɡlɪʃ ˈjuːs ˈpiːk?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It peaks in December, when many students work part-time in hotels.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈpiːks ɪn dɪˈsɛmbər, wɛn ˈmɛni ˈstuːdənts ˈwɜːrk ˌpɑːrt ˈtaɪm ɪn hoʊˈtɛlz.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Interesting. And what do the colors represent?
dialogue.reading: ˈɪntrəstɪŋ. ənd ˈwʌt duː ðə ˈkʌlərz ˌrɛprɪˈzɛnt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Blue represents speaking, and green represents reading.
dialogue.reading: ˈbluː ˌrɛprɪˈzɛnts ˈspiːkɪŋ, ənd ˈɡriːn ˌrɛprɪˈzɛnts ˈriːdɪŋ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: So what does the graph indicate overall?
dialogue.reading: soʊ ˈwʌt dʌz ðə ˈɡræf ˈɪndɪkeɪt ˌoʊvərˈɔːl?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: It indicates that students read much more than they speak.
dialogue.reading: ɪt ˈɪndɪkeɪts ðæt ˈstuːdənts ˈriːd ˈmʌtʃ ˈmɔːr ðən ðeɪ ˈspiːk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: That's clear. But the blue and the green look very similar on the screen.
dialogue.reading: ðæts ˈklɪr. bʌt ðə ˈbluː ənd ðə ˈɡriːn ˈlʊk ˈvɛri ˈsɪmələr ɑːn ðə ˈskriːn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: You're right. I'll make the speaking line orange.
dialogue.reading: jʊr ˈraɪt. aɪl ˈmeɪk ðə ˈspiːkɪŋ ˈlaɪn ˈɔːrɪndʒ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Good idea. A good graph illustrates your point quickly.
dialogue.reading: ˈɡʊd aɪˈdiːə. ə ˈɡʊd ˈɡræf ˈɪləstreɪts jʊr ˈpɔɪnt ˈkwɪkli.
